Users.title: Users
Users.description: Create accounts, set initial passwords and assign roles. Players cannot sign themselves up.
Users.deactivateDescription: They will be signed out right away and cannot sign in until you activate them again. Their data is kept.
Users.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots and underscores.
Users.passwordHint: At least {min, number} characters. Shown as you type so you can pass it on.
Users.createDescription: They sign in with these details. Share the password with them directly.
Users.editDescription: Changing the username changes how they sign in.
Users.selfRoleHint: You cannot change your own role.
Users.resetDescription: They are signed out everywhere and must use the new password.

Questions.title: Question bank
Questions.description: Write questions in MDX with sample and hidden tests. Quizzes pick their questions from here.
Questions.noMatchText: Try a different title, tag or difficulty, or clear the filters.
Questions.emptyText: Create the first question, then add sample and hidden tests to it.

QuestionEditor.descriptionNew: Write the statement and set the limits. You add tests once the question is created.

TestCases.intro: Each test is a program input (stdin) and the expected output. Sample tests are shown to students. Hidden tests are only used for grading and never leave the server.
TestCases.emptyText: Add a sample test students can see, then hidden tests for grading.
TestCases.maxReached: This question has the maximum of {max, number} tests.
TestCases.deleteDescription: The test is removed from the question and from grading. It cannot be undone.
